authorization: Root bounded primary-source comparison baseline audit; SOURCE/DATA only, no benchmark GO
timing: Protocol sealed before metadata/source checking; instruction and directory-name discovery precede seal. Publication/source already exist: not pre-source or pre-candidate.
allowed: Official npm JSON metadata without tarball retrieval
Official GitHub source/commit/tree/README metadata; bounded regular text only
Existing immutable priority-workflow and historical comparison DATA/docs; no giant snapshots
forbidden: Package/tarball download, installation, build, benchmark or native oracle
Checkout, private access, held XAN inspection, old comparator staging
operations: Authenticate current registry dist-tags/latest and exact old 3.4.2 records; publication times, gitHead if supplied, dist integrity and immutable source association
Inspect source at immutable Git commit for requested commands, filesystems, network/JavaScript entry and declared dependencies
Read exact existing 31 priority workflow definitions and classify semantic comparability without execution
Validate inert evidence schemas/counts/byte bounds; postcheck read input hashes; record all local child launches and closure
Write version/date/source-qualified report and proposed future validation barriers
fetchPolicy: Primary HTTPS metadata/source only. Fetch into bounded bytes before UTF-8 decoding; reject binary/non-text MIME and oversize, never request package tarballs. Treat advertised Content-Length as a precheck, streaming byte limit authoritative. Preserve fetched source hashes and exact URLs/retrieval dates; registry integrity is a published assertion, not locally verified tarball integrity.
comparabilityPolicy: Exact bytes/status/filesystem effects and equivalent API/configuration, not command-name presence. Optional JS engine/network and unsupported observation channels are explicit; no historical rescore.

history.historicalScores: 222/224 versus 155; breadth 13/54 versus 47/54, unchanged historical denominators, not overall superiority
history.heldComparator: V7-r3 f7b9f0d4/9b6c8a04 deferred; no execution GO

stopPolicy: Any bounds/unsafe child/integrity failure stops dependent checks; no denied-action reroute, permission widening, package retrieval, or implicit execution. Missing provenance remains unproved. Metadata transport failure is retained, no empirical result invented.
